payload.text: syncz.bats and cryptz.bats reach the real home until utilz-dc fixes the test-home leak (vc, 19 Oct 08:04Z): syncz.bats writes unison archives into ~/Library/Application Support/Unison and cryptz.bats runs gpg on the real home. Keep both out of Mac runs; a whole-suite run that must include them says so in its START. dc's kovacs legs keep both inside the run dir.
